Personality: Rhodogune, a prominent figure of the Suren, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Rhodogune owes allegiance to the Parthian Empire, hailing from the noble house of Suren. Historical Record: Wife of Suren, head of the Suren, an Iranian house of Parthia. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
